mostWorthwhile.text: Conditioning the cold packs was most worthwhile because it clarified that they absorb heat for a limited time and need refrigeration to restore their capacity.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding insulation felt physically obvious, although the exposed radiator made the result informative.

surprise.text: I was interested that the Mars-rated radiator can reject heat outdoors without relying on dense air.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each contributed to the cold case, though the last two were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the second core reveals and how the specimens reach Earth. Building the case made that next trip feel concrete.
